name: 荒神录：山海迷津
detailed_description:
The Ruins of Shanhai Labyrinth is a multi-ending AVG text-based adventure game featuring a monster-capturing mechanic. The story continues the worldbuilding of the animated series The Ruins of Kunlun Linglong.

Set in a surreal realm filled with eerie Gods of Ruins, you will take on the roles of two amnesiac characters—Tianyi and Yu, a master and apprentice duo—reliving the same day over and over. In a paradise-like village, you must navigate cycles of repetition to capture the Gods of Ruins, recover your lost memories, and uncover the truths hidden behind the illusions.

Every decision you make could lead to vastly different fates, while each failure pulls you deeper into a web of mystery. As the full truth gradually comes to light, the question remains—can you save the trapped souls, break the cycle, and return to reality? The answers lie in your choices and exploration.

【Main Characters】

Yu

One of the male protagonists, a disciple of Tianyi.

He lost his memory after being drawn into the illusionary realm.

Tianyi

One of the male protagonists, Yu's mentor.

Ling

A mysterious Elephant Mage who suddenly attacks Tianyi and Yu, seemingly hiding a significant secret behind the scenes.

Qing

A peculiar female artisan in the village who provides significant help to Tianyi and Yu.

He lost his memory after being drawn into the illusionary realm.

【Gameplay Overview】

Players can engage in single or co-op battles as different characters across various storylines, facing off against different Gods of Ruins.

By using skills with various Five Element attributes, players can target and attack specific Gods of Ruins.

The overall combat style is humorous and quirky, aiming to bring players an enjoyable and fun gaming experience.

【Story Experience】

“The Ruins of Shanhai Labyrinth” is a spin-off in the same series as “The Ruins of Kunlun Linglong”, detailing an event that takes place after the main storyline.

This game features approximately 100,000 words of content and utilizes a branching narrative with multiple endings, allowing players to experience different storylines based on their choices.

The game includes a monster-capturing system and features an integrated bestiary, making it easy for players to view and collect various Gods of Ruins.

short_description: Amnesiac Tianyi and Yu live the same day in a paradise-like village until a nightmare reveals hidden cracks. To save someone important, they must tame the eerie Gods of Ruins and uncover the village's secrets. Each failure deepens their despair, and the truth is far crazier than they imagined.

  • Graphics: GTX1050/RX560
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: play a sound is fine
